select TREE_ID treeId, P_ID pId, TREE_NAME treeName, FLAG from rep_tree T LEFT JOIN REP_INFO B ON T.TREE_ID=B.REP_ID where 1=1 AND (T.FLAG IS NULL OR T.FLAG='C' OR B.REPORT_TYPE='Y')
and TREE_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{tmpCName}),'%')
ORDER BY B.REP_ORDER

select REP_ID repId, TEMPLATE_ID templateId, TEMPLATE_PATH templatePath, REPORT_NAME reportName, REPORT_TYPE, CREATE_USER, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, CREATE_DEPT from REP_INFO where 1=1 AND REP_INFO.REPORT_TYPE='Y'
AND REPORT_NAME LIKE concat(concat('%',#{reportName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}),'%')
ORDER BY REP_ORDER
